title: fix(metadata): add `"type": "module"` to fix ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on Vercel
body:
Vercel serverless runtime resolves `@objectstack/metadata` to `src/index.ts` instead of compiled `dist/` output, causing `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` at runtime in `apps/studio/api/index.js`.

### Changes

- **`packages/metadata/package.json`**: Add `"type": "module"` and update exports from `.mjs`/`.js` to `.js`/`.cjs` — aligning with `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/runtime`, and `@objectstack/rest` which all resolve correctly on Vercel

```diff
+  "type": "module",
   "exports": {
     ".": {
-      "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
-      "require": "./dist/index.js"
+      "import": "./dist/index.js",
+      "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
     },
```

All 154 metadata tests and 13 studio tests pass. Build output verified: tsup correctly emits `.js` (ESM) and `.cjs` (CJS) with `"type": "module"`.
